1.en: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

2.en: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

3.en: And when the mountains are removed

4.en: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

5.en: And when the wild beasts are gathered

6.en: And when the seas are filled with flame

7.en: And when the souls are paired

8.en: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

9.en: For what sin she was killed

10.en: And when the pages are made public

11.en: And when the sky is stripped away

12.en: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

13.en: And when Paradise is brought near,

14.en: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

15.en: So I swear by the retreating stars -

16.en: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -

17.en: And by the night as it closes in

18.en: And by the dawn when it breathes

19.en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

20.ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
20.en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

21.en: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

22.en: And your companion is not [at all] mad.

23.en: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.

24.en: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

25.en: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

27.en: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

28.en: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

29.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
29.en: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
